title: Proprietary Kaspa DAG metrics direct from our Rusty-Kaspa full node (v1.1.0, pru
description: Proprietary Kaspa DAG metrics direct from our Rusty-Kaspa full node (v1.1.0, pruned) — node-RPC data unavailable via public APIs. Returns block count, header count, difficulty, virtual DAA score, hashrate in TH/s, mempool size, DAG tip count, peer count, sync status; plus derived rates (blocks/sec, DAA/sec, sync age). Updated every 5 minutes. Informational research data — not investment advice.
